name: Read AI
description: Your meetings are full of decisions, context, and next steps that shouldn't stay locked in a recording. The Read AI connector gives Claude direct access to your meeting data - including full transcripts, summaries, action items, key questions, topics, and engagement metrics. Browse recent meetings or pull up a specific session and use what was actually said as the starting point for follow-up work: drafting documents, extracting commitments, prepping for the next conversation, or synthesizing themes across multiple calls.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Read AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Read AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.read.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Read AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read AI provides these MCP tools: get_meeting_by_id and list_meetings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Read AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Read AI in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does Read AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Read AI is developed by Read AI. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
